verdict.rationale: Git-push-triggered deployment is a fair question for a cloud app platform like Fly.io, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents manual deploys via the `fly launch` CLI and the Machines REST API. Nothing shows an automatic deploy on Git push, a Git integration, or a documented CI pipeline. The CLI and REST API are building blocks a developer could script from, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can automatically deploy my app on every Git push
